# PREFIX-947A — Adjacent-core quotient-gap theorem and complete k=21/k=23 overlap census

**Date:** 2026-11-20. **Frozen input:** `f42f2906d77f24085c123f3ccfe9667d41caa96d`. **Domain:** Enterprise Math R6 auxiliary named-XOR two-port observer, strictly 19-bit odd moduli, 19 source-bit positions. No assertion about native X6/BRC physical dynamics. **Status:** author-proved theorem; exact full finite census; mathematical independent review pending; not admitted.

## New theorem, proof

Let `Q={262145,262147,...,524287}` and `0<=i,j,I,J<=18`. Suppose positive integers k,t,T and one common ordered modulus pair `(a,b) in Q^2` simultaneously satisfy

```
(k*a XOR 2^j)-2^i = t*b
((k+2)*a XOR 2^J)-2^I = T*b.
```

Then **`0 <= T-t <= 6`**, even when the two witnesses use different named source bits.

**Proof.** Put `s_j(x)=1-2*bit_j(x)` in `{-1,+1}`, so that `x XOR 2^j=x+s_j(x)*2^j`. Subtraction gives

```
(T-t)*b = 2a + s_J((k+2)a)*2^J - s_j(ka)*2^j - 2^I + 2^i.
```

For all admitted source positions, the signed XOR-bit difference is between `-2^19` and `2^19`. The endpoint-bit difference lies between `-(2^18-1)` and `2^18-1`. With `L=262145<=a<=H=524287` this proves

```
-262141 = 2L-2^19-(2^18-1) <= (T-t)*b
(T-t)*b <= 2H+2^19+(2^18-1) = 1835005.
```

Because `b>=262145`, one has `-b < (T-t)b < 7b`, since `7*262145=1835015>1835005`. The integer T-t is one of 0,1,2,3,4,5,6. QED. The quotient restriction is uniform in k for the stated input domain; state legality of the underlying trajectories is a separate condition and is satisfied in the actual k=21,23 experiment.

## Exact joint-direction census for 21 and 23

Read the complete frozen sorted `PREFIX946_W21.bin` and `PREFIX946_NEW21.bin` from the original locally verified PREFIX-946 package, plus `PREFIX947_W23.bin` from the independent CSR-checked PREFIX-947 computation. A streaming two-way ID merge gives:

- **`|W21 ∩ W23| = 137,274`**, sorted intersection SHA-256 `54c35a06874167484f0028443be45d3b03e69bc3bdf0e64fc97cf371522f6223`.
- **`|NEW21 ∩ W23| = 2,237`**, sorted SHA-256 `95fec135f28b0ec4986e5ebd3352ee70b06197bf0efc055071c7f6b48ba07e8c`; this matches the independently checked W21 priority bucket from PREFIX-947.
- On the same predecessor P19 baseline, `|W21\P19|=6,504,313`, `|W23\P19|=6,492,260`, their overlap is 2,237, and their distinct union adds **12,994,336** previously uncovered pairs relative to P19. Only **0.0343925638%** of NEW21's pairs also belong to W23. This is *relative sparse overlap of finite certificate classes*, not statistical independence or native X6 orthogonality.

The earliest common pair is `(a,b)=(262145,274433)`, with k21 source witness `(i,j,t)=(14,0,20)` and k23 source witness `(I,J,T)=(0,13,22)` (gap 2). The earliest `NEW21∩W23` pair is `(272395,520725)`, k21 witness `(9,13,11)` and k23 witness `(14,0,12)` (gap 1).

## All source-witness combinations checked, with nonexclusive pair counts

The separate executed C++17 checker enumerates every one of the 137,274 common modulus pairs and all 361 named source pairs for each of k21 and k23, collecting all positive exact quotients. Its **10,550,450 cross-core witness combinations** satisfy the theorem's 0..6 jump restriction. Multiple source witnesses exist for at least one core on 132,972 common pairs.

| Quotient gap T-t | Witness combinations | Modulus pairs with at least one such gap |
| ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 | 6 | 6 |
| 1 | 644 | 443 |
| 2 | 10,548,252 | 135,795 |
| 3 | 1,314 | 840 |
| 4 | 231 | 190 |
| 5 | 3 | 3 |
| 6 | 0 | 0 |

The pair-level gap categories may overlap, so their counts must not be added. The absence of gap 6 is an **exhaustive k21/k23 finite observation**; the general theorem gives 0..6. Observed full gap-pass process time 0.21 seconds and peak RSS 1,664 KiB, excluding preparation, sorting, compilation and hashing.

Evidence bundle `PREFIX947A_R6_twin_core_gap_reproduction.zip`: 8 entries including proof, exact result JSON, two C++17 programs, actual logs, and both sorted intersection binary streams; 492,788 bytes, ZIP CRC test passed; SHA-256 `318fbceb322e94184a376db7ae24de847b043e4a4250540a4709e4bb03aa93b6`. All arithmetic exact integer.
